data.content_ref: inline:SRC_004 inherits the algebraic reduction of SRC_002 but contradicts it on causal sufficiency: while SRC_002 depends on arithmetic substitution to derive P=1.25, SRC_004 argues that without a price-determination mechanism (e.g., supply/demand) the derivation is mathematically valid but causally incomplete. This is refuted if algebraic constraint satisfaction is accepted as a complete explanation of price, or if an implicit cost-plus pricing mechanism is inferred from the transaction context.
